summary: Anderson County, TX Texas Forest Service tower indexed as Montalba (Wilkerson Mtn); on a 1982 USGS map and in a 1993 sale notice; listed as gone. No removal record or site description found.

facts.status_note: Marked Tower Gone in the Forest Fire Lookout Association county list; the 1993 notice offered it for dismantling and removal, but no source confirms the work or its date

events.note: A 1982 USGS topographic map of the Wilkerson Mountain area, as described by Pastmaps, shows a Lookout Tower among its features

Sealed bids invited, on a notice dated January 15, 1993, for the sale, dismantling and removal of Texas Forest Service fire lookout towers, including the Montalba tower; bids due February 23, 1993. Completion is not documented.

notes_for_editor: The 1993 sale notice names only Montalba. The link to the Wilkerson Mountain record rests on the Forest Fire Lookout Association name 'Montalba (Wilkerson Mtn)' and on the 1982 map showing a Lookout Tower near Montalba, so treat the identity as likely, not proven. No build date, staffing or fire history found. No source says whether the 1993 sale went through or when the tower came down. Access and site-today are left out or stated as unknown.
